mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-significant positive 20d returns (t-test p > 0.05) despite a sustained downward trend in FEDFUNDS over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.7% triggers a labor market adjustment, reducing growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in the current month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive despite UNRATE exceeding 6.7% by >0.3pp in the current month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both GDPC1 (total economic demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signals robust demand-side growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase over the past month
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST do not both increase in the same month, or SPX 20d returns are not positive when they do.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.5% signals reduced policy accommodation, prompting capital inflows and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 0.5% in the current month
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains above 0.5% in the tightening cycle, or SPX 20d returns are not positive despite the decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) over the past quarter indicates healthy production growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO shows no upward trend over the past quarter, or SPX 60d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO below 100 signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 100 in the current month
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above 100 despite SPX 5d returns being positive.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both PAYEMS (labor demand) and UNRATE (labor supply) indicates a balanced labor market, reducing inflationary pressures and prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and UNRATE increase over the past month
failure_condition: PAYEMS and UNRATE do not both increase in the same month, or SPX 20d returns are not positive when they do.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in PAYEMS below 140,000 signals labor market saturation, reducing growth prospects and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS falls below 140,000 in the current month
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains above 140,000 in the late-cycle expansion, or SPX 20d returns are positive despite the drop.
